description:
Intent i005 (SNAPSHOT=s01, BRANCH=ioctl-sock-usercopy-string) complete. Programmatic scan of all s01 .c files found 283 functions pairing a usercopy primitive with a string op (231 after excluding memdup_user_nul/strndup_user users). Three high-confidence findings, all verified line-by-line with literal in-range quotes:

1. drivers/s390/cio/cio_inject.c:98-107 (crw_inject_write): vmemdup_user(buf, lbuf) allocates exactly lbuf bytes with no terminator slot, no length cap on lbuf, then sscanf(buffer, "%x %x %x %x %x %x %x", ...) at line 102 scans until NUL — OOB heap read when user write lacks a NUL byte. Debugfs 'crw_inject' node (0200) is the untrusted source.

2. drivers/net/ethernet/brocade/bna/bnad_debugfs.c:315-319 (bnad_debugfs_write_regrd) and again at 375-379 (write_regwr): memdup_user(buf, nbytes) then sscanf(kern_buf, "%x:%x", ...) with no memdup_user_nul/strndup_user/terminator anywhere in the file — a structural clone of the seed scsi/bfa bfad_debugfs bug in the same Brocade BFA code family.

3. drivers/net/ethernet/intel/ice/ice_debugfs.c:174-184 (ice_debugfs_module_write, repeated at 260/335/431): memdup_user(buf, count) with count clamped to <=8 but no NUL guarantee, then sscanf(cmd_buf, "%s", user_val) at line 184 — an 8-byte non-NUL write makes %s scan past the allocation (secondary unbounded %s into char[16]).

Safe (rejected with evidence): xfs_attrmulti_attr_set (memdup data used as binary xattr value; name is strndup_user'd), btrfs ioctls (memchr-forced in-bounds NUL via btrfs_check_ioctl_vol_args_path), hiddev ioctl (fixed-size struct copies; strlen only on kernel strings), ipvs do_ip_vs_get_ctl (copylen-checked fixed array), yurex_write (buffer[16+1] with buffer[count]=0 clamp), proc_scsi_write (explicit in-bounds *end='\0'), rvu_debugfs (count+1 alloc plus cmd_buf[count]='\0').

Unresolved/limitations: i40e_debugfs write handlers and mm/huge_memory split_huge_pages_write flagged but not fully re-verified before audit stop; the netlink nla_data/nla_string policy sweep and compat_ioctl-specific sweeps were only partially executed within the general scan; no runtime KASAN reproducer was run (read-only snapshot, findings are structural hypotheses). Full detail in agent-state/findings/i005.json.
